text.en:
'These constitutional bodies shall promulgate guidelines
on travels abroad for their members, officials and employees.
The members, officials and employees of the afore-
mentioned constitutional bodies shall henceforth submit their requests
for pemission to travel abroad to the heads of the Cormissions/Office

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 21st. day of August, in the
year of Our lord, nineteen hundred and ninety-one.
paragon to. lewint
By the President:
FRANKLIN M. DRILON
